g.text: ttt — architecture · two executables · protocol v3.0
main wires it up and dispatches to the controller
seats X then O, by arrival
the dialect, raw — one line per message:
HELLO · SEAT X · MOVE 5 · REFUSED taken · BYE
no seat on the wire: the socket IS the address
clients are THIN — no game logic here. Reply rule:
a question is ANSWERED, a change is BROADCAST.
